profile.Name: Yabuta of the Sands
profile.Personality: Crazy. Behind bars he makes grim jokes about his bad luck, but once free he laughs, vows to kill everyone, and claims the sands as his.
profile.Backstory: A prisoner in Tengu's Vault who claims he is there only for stealing a few greenfruits and picking pockets. The Yabuta Outlaws bear his name.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Wry complaints about lady luck; calls people "brother". Breaks into manic laughter once free.
